# The Debian reland kept a temporary localization revision workaround

Every path in the 785 landing was verified to return exactly to its original parent state in backout 791. Reland 792 differs from the original through the intervening manpage addition and a change that restores a hardcoded localization revision with a Bug 1912126 comment that says it remains until the script is updated for GitHub proper. No failure reason is stated in the backout message. Current build_desktop_file.py has since become a renderer that accepts locale data and Fluent resource inputs; it no longer establishes that historical fetch workaround as current practice. Treat the fixed revision as a historical compatibility exception and keep the later configurable resource interface. Review discussion and actual failure diagnostics remain unread.

Scope: debian-localization-chain.
